title: Naturally Smoky Italian Dates Skewers
description: Umami rich Italian dish featuring stoned dates, perfect for a date night, made with satvik friendly ingredients and cooked on a robata grill to bring out the natural smokiness.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the pitted dates onto skewers, leaving a small space between each date.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, minced garlic, sea salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the dates, making sure they are fully coated.
Sprinkle the chopped basil leaves, toasted pine nuts, and shaved parmesan cheese over the dates.
Place the skewers on the robata grill and cook for 8 minutes, turning occasionally.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with lemon zest.
Serve the smoky Italian dates skewers immediately, garnished with additional basil leaves if desired.
